targets.rawSql:
SELECT tcp_connected AS value
FROM mc_companion_info
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  cast(node_name as varchar) AS value
FROM mc_companion_info
WHERE node_name IS NOT NULL
  AND model IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  (now() - ts) / 60000000 AS minutes
FROM mc_companion_info
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  cast(model as varchar) AS value
FROM mc_companion_info
WHERE node_name IS NOT NULL
  AND model IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT cast(firmware as varchar) AS value
FROM mc_companion_info
WHERE firmware IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT noise_floor AS value
FROM mc_companion_info
WHERE noise_floor IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT count() AS kontakte
FROM mc_contacts;

SELECT
  left(public_key, length('$repeater')) ||
  ' • ' ||
  coalesce(adv_name, '') AS value
FROM mc_contacts
WHERE public_key LIKE '$repeater%'

UNION ALL

SELECT '$repeater' AS value
FROM long_sequence(1)

LIMIT 1;

WITH window_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    min(ts) AS ts_min,
    max(ts) AS ts_max
  FROM mc_rx
  WHERE
    airtime_ms IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(ts)
    AND repeater LIKE '${repeater}%'
),
repeater_airtime AS (
  SELECT
    sum(airtime_ms) AS airtime_ms_sum
  FROM mc_rx
  WHERE
    airtime_ms IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(ts)
    AND repeater LIKE '${repeater}%'
)
SELECT
  round(
    100.0 * r.airtime_ms_sum /
    greatest((w.ts_max - w.ts_min) / 1000.0, 1.0),
    4
  ) AS duty_cycle_percent
FROM repeater_airtime r
CROSS JOIN window_bounds w;

SELECT
  count_distinct(prev_hop) AS neighbors
FROM mc_rx
WHERE
  repeater LIKE '${repeater}%'
  AND prev_hop IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)

SELECT
  count_distinct(sender_node) AS senders
FROM mc_rx
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND repeater LIKE '${repeater}%'
  AND sender_node IS NOT NULL

WITH hash_counts AS (
  SELECT
    path_hash_size,
    count() AS packets
  FROM mc_rx
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
    AND repeater LIKE '${repeater}%'
  GROUP BY path_hash_size
),
total AS (
  SELECT sum(packets) AS total_packets FROM hash_counts
)
SELECT
  concat(cast(path_hash_size as string), ' byte') AS hash_size,
  round(100.0 * packets / total_packets, 1) AS percent
FROM hash_counts
CROSS JOIN total
ORDER BY percent DESC;

SELECT
  ts,
  count() AS packets
FROM mc_rx
WHERE
  repeater LIKE '${repeater}%'
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)
SAMPLE BY 1h

SELECT
    (hop_count + 1) AS hop,
    count(*) AS packets
FROM mc_rx
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND repeater LIKE '${repeater}%'
GROUP BY hop
ORDER BY hop;

WITH totals AS (
  SELECT count() AS total_count
  FROM mc_rx
  WHERE
    repeater LIKE '${repeater}%'
    AND $__timeFilter(ts)
)
SELECT
  sum(CASE WHEN payload_type = 'REQ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / t.total_count AS REQ,
  sum(CASE WHEN payload_type = 'ANON_REQ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / t.total_count AS ANON_REQ,
  sum(CASE WHEN payload_type = 'RESPONSE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / t.total_count AS RESPONSE,
  sum(CASE WHEN payload_type = 'TEXT_MSG' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / t.total_count AS TEXT_MSG,
  sum(CASE WHEN payload_type = 'PATH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / t.total_count AS PATH,
  sum(CASE WHEN payload_type = 'ACK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / t.total_count AS ACK,
  sum(CASE WHEN payload_type = 'GRP_TXT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / t.total_count AS GRP_TXT,
  sum(CASE WHEN payload_type = 'CONTROL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / t.total_count AS CONTROL,
  sum(CASE WHEN payload_type = 'ADVERT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / t.total_count AS ADVERT
FROM mc_rx
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE
  repeater LIKE '${repeater}%'
  AND $__timeFilter(ts);

SELECT
    payload_type,
    count(*) AS packets
FROM mc_rx
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND repeater LIKE '${repeater}%'
GROUP BY payload_type
ORDER BY packets DESC;

WITH top_neighbors AS (
  SELECT
    prev_hop,
    sum(airtime_ms) AS total_airtime_ms
  FROM mc_rx
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(ts)
    AND repeater LIKE '${repeater}%'
    AND prev_hop IS NOT NULL
    AND airtime_ms IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY prev_hop
  ORDER BY total_airtime_ms DESC
  LIMIT 10
)

SELECT
  mc_rx.prev_hop || '*' AS neighbor,

  round(sum(CASE WHEN mc_rx.payload_type = 'REQ' THEN mc_rx.airtime_ms ELSE 0 END) / 1000.0, 2) AS req,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN mc_rx.payload_type = 'ANON_REQ' THEN mc_rx.airtime_ms ELSE 0 END) / 1000.0, 2) AS anon_req,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN mc_rx.payload_type = 'RESPONSE' THEN mc_rx.airtime_ms ELSE 0 END) / 1000.0, 2) AS response,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN mc_rx.payload_type = 'TEXT_MSG' THEN mc_rx.airtime_ms ELSE 0 END) / 1000.0, 2) AS text_msg,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN mc_rx.payload_type = 'PATH' THEN mc_rx.airtime_ms ELSE 0 END) / 1000.0, 2) AS path,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN mc_rx.payload_type = 'ACK' THEN mc_rx.airtime_ms ELSE 0 END) / 1000.0, 2) AS ack,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN mc_rx.payload_type = 'GRP_TXT' THEN mc_rx.airtime_ms ELSE 0 END) / 1000.0, 2) AS grp_txt

FROM mc_rx

JOIN top_neighbors
  ON mc_rx.prev_hop = top_neighbors.prev_hop

WHERE
  $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND mc_rx.repeater LIKE '${repeater}%'
  AND mc_rx.airtime_ms IS NOT NULL

GROUP BY
  mc_rx.prev_hop,
  top_neighbors.total_airtime_ms

ORDER BY
  top_neighbors.total_airtime_ms DESC

WITH top_neighbors AS (
  SELECT
    prev_hop,
    sum(airtime_ms) AS total_airtime_ms
  FROM mc_rx
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(ts)
    AND repeater LIKE '${repeater}%'
    AND prev_hop IS NOT NULL
    AND airtime_ms IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY prev_hop
  ORDER BY total_airtime_ms DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
match_counts AS (
  SELECT
    tn.prev_hop,
    count(mc_contacts.public_key) AS contact_count
  FROM top_neighbors tn
  LEFT JOIN mc_contacts
    ON substring(mc_contacts.public_key, 1, length(tn.prev_hop)) = tn.prev_hop
  GROUP BY tn.prev_hop
)

SELECT
  tn.prev_hop || '*' AS "Node",
  mc_contacts.adv_name AS "Name",
  substring(mc_contacts.public_key, 1, 6) || '*' AS "Public Key",
  mc_contacts.public_key AS node_key
FROM top_neighbors tn
LEFT JOIN mc_contacts
  ON substring(mc_contacts.public_key, 1, length(tn.prev_hop)) = tn.prev_hop
LEFT JOIN match_counts mc
  ON tn.prev_hop = mc.prev_hop
ORDER BY
  tn.total_airtime_ms DESC,
  mc_contacts.adv_name

SELECT
  r.ts AS time,
  r.frame_bytes AS " ",
  r.txt_msg_src_hash || '→' || r.txt_msg_dest_hash AS metric
FROM mc_rx r
JOIN (
  SELECT
    txt_msg_src_hash,
    txt_msg_dest_hash,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM mc_rx
  WHERE payload_type = 'TEXT_MSG'
    AND txt_msg_src_hash IS NOT NULL
    AND txt_msg_dest_hash IS NOT NULL
    AND repeater LIKE '${repeater}%'
    AND $__timeFilter(ts)
  GROUP BY txt_msg_src_hash, txt_msg_dest_hash
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 10
) t
ON r.txt_msg_src_hash = t.txt_msg_src_hash
AND r.txt_msg_dest_hash = t.txt_msg_dest_hash
WHERE r.payload_type = 'TEXT_MSG'
  AND r.txt_msg_src_hash IS NOT NULL
  AND r.txt_msg_dest_hash IS NOT NULL
  AND r.repeater LIKE '${repeater}%'
  AND $__timeFilter(r.ts)
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN payload_route_type IN ('0','3') THEN 'mit Region'
    WHEN payload_route_type = '1' THEN 'ohne Region'
    WHEN payload_route_type = '2' THEN 'mit Pfad'
    ELSE 'unbekannt'
  END AS route_scope,

  round(sum(airtime_ms) / 1000.0, 2) AS airtime_seconds

FROM mc_rx

WHERE
    $__timeFilter(ts)
    AND repeater LIKE '${repeater}%'
    AND airtime_ms IS NOT NULL
    AND payload_route_type IS NOT NULL

GROUP BY
    CASE
      WHEN payload_route_type IN ('0','3') THEN 'mit Region'
      WHEN payload_route_type = '1' THEN 'ohne Region'
      WHEN payload_route_type = '2' THEN 'mit Pfad'
      ELSE 'unbekannt'
    END

ORDER BY airtime_seconds DESC;

SELECT
  adv_name AS name,
  public_key,
  adv_lat AS latitude,
  adv_lon AS longitude
FROM mc_contacts
WHERE
  adv_lat IS NOT NULL
  AND adv_lon IS NOT NULL

SELECT
  adv_name AS name,
  public_key,
  adv_lat AS latitude,
  adv_lon AS longitude
FROM mc_contacts
WHERE
  adv_lat IS NOT NULL
  AND adv_lon IS NOT NULL
  AND public_key = '${node}'

SELECT
  region,
  count(*) AS packets
FROM mc_rx
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND repeater LIKE '${repeater}%'
  AND region IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY packets DESC;

SELECT
  channel AS label,
  count(*) AS packets
FROM mc_rx
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND repeater LIKE '${repeater}%'
  AND channel IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY packets DESC, channel;

SELECT
  grp_txt_sender_name,
  count() AS packets
FROM mc_rx
WHERE
  payload_type = 'GRP_TXT'
  AND grp_txt_sender_name IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY grp_txt_sender_name
ORDER BY packets DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT
  channel,
  region,
  count() AS packets
FROM mc_rx
WHERE
  payload_type = 'GRP_TXT'
  AND region IS NOT NULL
  AND channel IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY channel, region
ORDER BY channel, packets DESC

SELECT
  region,
  channel,
  count() AS packets
FROM mc_rx
WHERE
  payload_type = 'GRP_TXT'
  AND region IS NOT NULL
  AND channel IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY region, channel
ORDER BY region, packets DESC
